about: Art. 71 opt-out rewrite (ADR-062): each query and what secondaryUseView() must turn it into. Shared by services/neo4j-proxy/src/opt-out.ts and ui/src/lib/opt-out.ts, so the two copies of the rewrite cannot drift.

vectors.name: OMOP rows
vectors.in: MATCH (co:OMOPConditionOccurrence) WHERE co.conditionSourceValue CONTAINS $concept RETURN co.conditionSourceValue AS group, count(co) AS count
vectors.out: MATCH (co:(OMOPConditionOccurrence)&!OptedOut) WHERE co.conditionSourceValue CONTAINS $concept RETURN co.conditionSourceValue AS group, count(co) AS count

vectors.name: relationship types and function calls are left alone
string literals and comments are left alone
vectors.in:
// (p:Patient) in a comment
MATCH (d:HealthDataset) WHERE d.title = '(p:Patient)' RETURN d
vectors.out:
// (p:Patient) in a comment
MATCH (d:HealthDataset) WHERE d.title = '(p:Patient)' RETURN d

vectors.name: a pattern that already excludes the marker
a pattern inside EXISTS and a sub-query
vectors.in: MATCH (d:HealthDataset) WHERE EXISTS { (d)<-[:FROM_DATASET]-(:Patient) } CALL { MATCH (p:Patient) RETURN collect(p) AS cohort } RETURN size(cohort)
vectors.out: MATCH (d:HealthDataset) WHERE EXISTS { (d)<-[:FROM_DATASET]-(:(Patient)&!OptedOut) } CALL { MATCH (p:(Patient)&!OptedOut) RETURN collect(p) AS cohort } RETURN size(cohort)

vectors.name: a vector search call and its expansion
vectors.in: CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('condition_embedding', 5, $embedding) YIELD node, score MATCH (pt:Patient)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(node) RETURN count(DISTINCT pt)
vectors.out: CALL db.index.vector.queryNodes('condition_embedding', 5, $embedding) YIELD node, score MATCH (pt:(Patient)&!OptedOut)-[:HAS_CONDITION]->(node) RETURN count(DISTINCT pt)
